name: Bastrop County, TX
findings: Bastrop County has 233 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bastrop County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 16 social and fraternal organizations here list public events, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 27 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
